description: This file defines utility functions and conversions for agent tools, including wrapping external tools into a standardized format, handling execution, error reporting, and parameter coercion within a tool management framework.

methods.name: isAbortSignal
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is an AbortSignal.

methods.name: isLegacyToolExecuteArgs
methods.description: Determines if given tool execution arguments are in legacy format.

methods.name: describeToolExecutionError
methods.description: Creates a descriptive object for an error encountered during tool execution.

methods.name: serializeToolParams
methods.description: Serializes various types of tool parameters into a string.

methods.name: formatToolParamPreview
methods.description: Prepares a sanitized preview string of a tool parameter.

methods.name: describeToolFailureInputs
methods.description: Generates a string describing the raw and effective parameters when a tool fails.

methods.name: normalizeToolExecutionResult
methods.description: Normalizes the result returned by a tool to a standard AgentToolResult format.

methods.name: buildToolExecutionErrorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result object for a tool failure.

methods.name: splitToolExecuteArgs
methods.description: Splits and interprets tool execution arguments into a standardized object.

methods.name: toToolDefinitions
methods.description: Converts an array of AgentTool objects into ToolDefinition objects with wrapped execute functions.

methods.name: coerceParamsRecord
methods.description: Attempts to parse string parameters into a plain object, falling back to empty object if parsing fails.

methods.name: toClientToolDefinitions
methods.description: Converts client-side tool definitions into ToolDefinition format with delegated execution handling.
